title: id/web: add the documents list/read panel for session frames (D1-040 remainder)

labels.name: app/id
labels.description: Package/app: id (pkgs/ or apps/ in this repo)

labels.name: effort/s
labels.description: Small: expected under 2 hours of work

body:
## Problem

PR #7678 delivered the `documents`/`document` session frames, server-side serving, and frame-backed SSH rendering for D1-040. Its body explicitly leaves the minimal web documents panel and web contract tests out of scope. Issue #3762 was closed by that merge even though its web-client acceptance remains; no later merged panel implementation was found.

## Acceptance

- The web client can list public documents using the existing `ClientFrame::Documents { capability, prefix, after }` flow and continue through `next_after` pages.
- Selecting a listed name reads through `ClientFrame::Document { capability, name }` and displays the returned name, size, and read-only text content.
- Add web client contract tests for first/subsequent pages, prefix filtering, document reads, missing/non-viewable/oversized refusals, and join denial.
- Existing SSH and session-frame behavior remains unchanged; the UI adds no document write/publish path.
- `cd pkgs/id/web && bun run test` passes through the required CI/Fleet venue, and any new test is covered by the existing id web suite registration.

## Scope

Implement only the missing web client panel and its contract tests. Do not redo the session frame/SSH implementation in PR #7678 or add document writes.

## Evidence

- PR #7678's body says the web documents panel and web contract tests are the remaining #3762 acceptance.
- `pkgs/id/web/src` has no `documents_continue` client implementation; no later merged PR for the panel was found.
- A Lane 2 closure-review pointer for the #3762 closure is on audit umbrella #13871: https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/13871#issuecomment-7156245156.
